description: Box mapping and padding (SPEC AC-192, AC-113, AC-118; ARCH §11.5; API-NOTES §5.8, §6.1; D-20, D-88). Single source of truth for web/src/core/boxes.test.ts (Vitest) and the iOS port (XCTest, AC-352). Each case has an `fn` naming the function under test, a human `name`, its inputs and an `expect` object.
conventions: Rects are {x, y, w, h} in pixels. box is Gemini's box_2d [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax], y first, normalised 0..1000 to the image AS SENT (never letterboxed).
A non-finite number is written as the string "NaN", "Infinity" or "-Infinity" (JSON has no literal for them).

box2dToPx(box, W, H): clamp each value to 0..1000 (non-finite → 0), swap reversed corners, multiply by W or H BEFORE dividing by 1000, floor the near edges and ceil the far edges, clamp to W×H. A zero-area box comes back with w or h 0.

box2dToMaster(box, frame): frame is an ImageFrame {id, width, height, cropInMaster}. Straight from 0..1000 to master pixels: x = crop.x + v × crop.w / 1000 (y likewise with crop.h), near edges floored, far edges ceiled, kept inside the crop. A box with a non-finite value or zero area after clamping → rect null.

cloudToMaster(rect, frame): exact (fractional) map from frame pixels to master pixels: x = crop.x + x × crop.w / width, w = w × crop.w / width (y and h with crop.h / height). x and y scale separately.
masterToBox2d(rect, frame): the inverse of box2dToMaster, rounded outward (min floored, max ceiled), clamped 0..1000.

padRect(rect, W, H, ratio?): ratio defaults to 0.15 and is clamped 0..0.5 (non-finite → 0.15). Per side: max(4, ceilPx(w × ratio / 2)) horizontally, max(4, ceilPx(h × ratio / 2)) vertically, where ceilPx(v) = ceil(v − 1e-9) so float noise (15.000000000000002) does not add a pixel; then rounded outward to whole pixels and clamped to W×H. A rect with a non-finite field or a negative w or h fails (`expect: {throws: true}`, D-97).
gridCellRect(region, W, H): 3×3 cells; column c spans round(c × W / 3) .. round((c + 1) × W / 3), rows likewise. The nine cells tile the frame exactly.
